workflow_description: Initializes the console table from various data sources such as POCOs, dictionaries, and arrays while enforcing structural integrity constraints.
integration_test: [Fact] public void DataIngestionAndStructureValidation_IntegrationTest() { var users = new List<User> { new User { Name = "Alice", Age = 30 } }; var pocoTable = ConsoleTable.From(users); Assert.Equal(2, pocoTable.Columns.Count); Assert.Equal("Name", pocoTable.Columns[0]); var dictData = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, object>> { { "RowKey", new Dictionary<string, object> { { "Col1", 100 } } } }; var dictTable = ConsoleTable.FromDictionary(dictData); Assert.Equal(2, dictTable.Columns.Count); Assert.Equal("RowKey", dictTable.Rows[0][0]); DataTable dt = new DataTable(); dt.Columns.Add("A"); dt.Rows.Add("Val"); var dtTable = ConsoleTable.From(dt); Assert.Single(dtTable.Columns); Object[][] arrayData = new Object[][] { new object[] { "H1" }, new object[] { "V1" } }; var arrayTable = ConsoleTable.From(arrayData); Assert.Single(arrayTable.Columns); Assert.Single(arrayTable.Rows); var manual = new ConsoleTable(); var ex1 = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => manual.AddRow(1, 2)); Assert.Equal("Please set the columns first", ex1.Message); manual.AddColumn(new[] { "C1", "C2" }); var ex2 = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => manual.AddRow(1)); Assert.Contains("does not match the values", ex2.Message); manual.AddRow(1, 2); Assert.Single(manual.Rows); }
